note: Data-driven utility definitions (brief 6.3). Abilities are mapped onto three generic primitives, not hand-coded per agent: los_blocker (smoke), blind (flash), area_damage (molly). Spatial values (radii, throw range, wave distance) are measured against the b_site platform scale; timing/damage values remain placeholders tuned by playtest. Abilities are deliberate approximations of the real tactical effect, not replicas of any specific agent's kit.
